meta: A self-check: how good are you at using AI? Watching lots of videos doesn't mean you use AI well, and these 5 questions show how far you've come.

muc.title: Five self-check questions
muc.text: Watching lots of videos doesn't mean you use AI well. These five questions show how far you've come.

muc.title: Writing and fixing prompts
muc.text: One: you can write a prompt with a role, examples and an answer format. Two: when the result isn't right, you know how to fix the prompt.

muc.title: Checking and staying safe
muc.text: Three: you always double-check numbers AI gives you. Four: you always remove personal information before pasting.

muc.title: One real task every week
muc.text: Five: every week you give AI at least one real task, at work or when writing.

muc.title: Score yourself
muc.text: Score yourself on the five questions, one point each, and post your score in the pinned comment.
